- Muscle biopsy revealing endomysial CD8+ T-lymphocyte infiltration — hallmark of immune-mediated myositis, particularly consistent with polymyositis or immune-mediated necrotizing myopathy (IMNM)

- Electrophysiology: EMG abnormalities consistent with primary myopathic process and active inflammation  
- Histopathology: Muscle biopsy shows CD8+ lymphocytic infiltration in the endomysium — indicative of cytotoxic T-cell–mediated myofiber damage
